title: Piezoelectric City Floors Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Piezoelectric City Floors operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Piezoelectric City Floors installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 64486 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where piezo tiles monitoring, floor logistics redundancy, or foot traffic maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Piezoelectric City Floors Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Piezoelectric City Floors: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Piezoelectric City Floors — city floors generating power from footsteps.

Phase 1 — Prove (piezo tiles): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (floor logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (foot traffic): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (grid tie-in): floor hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and transit hubs-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
